annotations.title: Send a message to a track

description: Hands an email (its From address, subject and text) or a JSON body to one of the person's own tracks, to be read by its hacks exactly as if they had forwarded it: the hacks' fixed rules make the rows, and schema checks, row keys, blocking rules and the Inbox all apply. Use this rather than add_rows for messages, so every row comes out the same way. A message no hack reads waits in the Inbox: then build a hack for it (suggest_hack, test_hack, save_hack) and rerun_inbox. The same message sent twice makes its rows once.

from.description: The original sender's address, like alerts@chase.com. Hacks limited to senders read only their senders' messages.

messageId.description: The email's Message-ID, if you have it.

text.description: The message's text as received, or a JSON body.

name: send_message
